title: Shielding PII to Prevent Re-identification and Preserve Utility

statements.text: Assume that SHIELD integrates a strong attacker A★ whose attack family covers all information-theoretic membership-inference (distinguishing) attacks between adjacent datasets D and D− 𝑗 based on the released output. Then, the anonymization mechanism 𝑀 induced by SHIELD satisfies 𝜖0 -differential privacy. □

Given a dataset D with risk graph 𝐺, a re-identification attacker A, and an anonymization action a of SHIELD, applying action a neither decreases privacy nor increases utility. □ Proc. ACM Manag. All four actions remove or coarsen identifying evidence in 𝐺, and thus yield a post-processed view with weakly less information for A. Therefore, A cannot increase its reidentification success probability, so privacy risk is monotone non-increasing. Each action takes edits, so similarity to the original D cannot improve, and utility cannot increase. See [39] for the full proof. □
